fusions.name: Stubble Burn
fusions.desc: Sweeps a burning arc through a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 11 fire damage and setting everything in it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Ash Harvest
fusions.desc: Throws a red-hot crescent that deals 16 fire damage to the first enemy it meets, uses up every affliction you have on it and deals 60% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Fallow Plot
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, the ground where you stand restores 3 health a second to you and any ally within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Embers Down the Row
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a spark jumps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, dealing 7 damage and setting it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
